meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会出现微信渠道,Claude 能通过个人微信账号收发消息:服务启动时用腾讯 iLink API 长轮询连接,扫码登录即可,无需 API 密钥或 Webhook。
howto.when: 当你说“添加微信渠道”“把微信接入智能体”等需求时,会执行此技能。

say.text: 帮我把微信渠道添加到 NanoClaw。
say.note: 开始安装微信适配器并检查依赖。

say.text: 扫码登录微信,把新消息接进来。
say.note: 打印二维码,扫码授权后保存登录状态。

say.text: 把微信会话接到智能体工作组 A。
say.note: 运行接线脚本,让智能体能回复微信消息。

howto.what_en: Adds a 'wechat' channel to NanoClaw so Claude can send and receive messages via a personal WeChat account. The adapter uses Tencent's iLink API with long-polling; you log in by scanning a QR code. No API keys or webhook are needed.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add or connect a WeChat channel, or want Claude to send/receive messages through WeChat.

say_en.text: Add the WeChat channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs the adapter and validates the environment.

say_en.text: Scan the QR code and start receiving WeChat messages.
say_en.note: Logs in and saves auth to data/wechat/auth.json.

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat chat to agent group A.
say_en.note: Creates the wiring so the agent can reply.
